messages:
jamal: Morning all — quick async checkin
jamal: Yesterday: finished the gateway rule refactor and merged PR #3421. Validated canary in staging.
jamal: Blockers: seeing sporadic 429s from thin-client path when burst test hits 95th percentile. Need someone to pair on rate-policy telemetry correlation.
jamal: Today: roll out small backoff + increase per-route burst tokens if canary looks good.
maria: Re: 429s — I ran the load test earlier, logs show tokens depleted on route `/v1/embed` after 7s. attaching snippet from config:

maria: ```
routes:
  - path: /v1/embed
    rate_limit:
      rps: 50
      burst: 100
```

kevin: I can pair at 10:30 PT. also glanced at the KV cache metrics — hit rate is fine.
kevin: Jamal, do you have the canary ID so I can pull the traces?
jamal: canary id `canary-7f2a` — thanks Kevin.
sophia: FYI I pushed a tiny change to the auth middleware to short-circuit on missing API key, should reduce some CPU churn. PR #3427.
lina: @sophia nice — will review. quick ask: is that deployed to staging already?
sophia: yes, staging only. no rollout to prod yet.
deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: user/sophia/short-circuit-auth @ staging (build 2026-03-17T08:12:10Z)
kevin: Also pinging @lina — can you check the token bucket exporter? I saw a gap in metrics between 08:05 and 08:09.
lina: on it, looking now.
lina: found delayed scrape on node-gw-3, restarting exporter.
lina: restarted, metrics resumed. exporting a short graph in #eng-sre.
jamal: thanks team. timeline: hold prod rollout until we confirm burst tweak + run another 30m canary.
maria: I'll prepare a short test script for targeted bursts — posting in thread when ready.
kevin: i'll pair with jamal at 10:30 PT and follow up in this thread. if anyone wants to join ping me.
sophia: quick note for docs: update routing policy docs about per-route burst default from 50->100. filing a docs PR.
maria: blocker resolved (for my part) — need kevin & jamal to greenlight canary.
jamal: ack. last thing — anyone saw alerts about auth latencies earlier? got ping from support.
lina: support reported slow login at 07:58 UTC, but traces show external id provider slowness. filing incident? probably external.
jamal: ok, mark as external for now. thanks.
kevin: tl;dr: schedule — pair @ 10:30PT; maria test script; hold prod rollout until another 30m canary.
jamal: :thumbsup:
